title: grim-consistency-v1 player output
description: Per-statistic granularity-consistency judgements. One record per reported statistic.

issue_kind.description: The inconsistency kind when flagged=true; null otherwise. grim_inconsistent: a stat_type='mean' value that cannot arise from any achievable integer total at the stated 1/N granularity. grim_percent_inconsistent: a stat_type='percent' value that equals no achievable count k/N*100 at the stated 100/N granularity.

flagged.description: True if this statistic's reported value (mean or percentage) is GRIM-inconsistent.

confidence.description: Player's confidence in the flagged judgement.
